conditions.note: one world and one tab per run; a benchmark must not share the GPU with builds, renders or other agents

isolation.processLock: exclusive; a second benchmark cannot start while this one holds it
isolation.browser: one browser context, one page, a fresh document per TTI attempt
isolation.note: the canary scenario was measured first and last; its drift bounds what this run can claim

readiness.definition: diorama-ready after preload, shader warm-up, first interactive animation frame and loader dismissal
